records.quote: In this work, we investigate the thermal and electrical transport properties of rhombohedral ASbTe2 (A = Li, Na, K) with space group R-3m using first-principles calculations, Boltzmann transport theory, combined with unified thermal transport theory incorporating higher-order scattering.

records.subject: Strong four-phonon interactions
records.conditions: Rhombohedral ASbTe2 (A = Li, Na, K), R-3m; first-principles calculations, Boltzmann transport theory and unified thermal transport theory incorporating higher-order scattering
records.quote: In this work, we investigate the thermal and electrical transport properties of rhombohedral ASbTe2 (A = Li, Na, K) with space group R-3m using first-principles calculations, Boltzmann transport theory, combined with unified thermal transport theory incorporating higher-order scattering.
context_quotes: It is found that strong four-phonon interactions significantly suppress heat transport, leading to low 'particle-like' lattice thermal conductivities (kappa p) at room temperature, with values of 0.62 W mK-1 for LiSbTe2, 0.81 W mK-1 for NaSbTe2, and 0.97 W mK-1 for KSbTe2, respectively.
